##Optional..
#If we would like, we can block a particular ca by putting them in the block store

##First, Create Backups in Controller Node.
mkdir backup
mkdir backup

sudo su
cd /var/lib/k0s/
mv ./pki/* /home/bsfintech/backup/
rm -rf pki

##After Removing pki, if the k0scontroller is restarted, the pki is newly generated
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart k0scontroller

##Adding newly generated kubernetes-ca to the trust store
cd pki
sudo trust anchor --store ca.crt
sudo update-ca-trust extract

##Adding newly generated etcd-ca to the trust store
cd etcd
sudo trust anchor --store ca.crt
sudo update-ca-trust extract

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart k0scontroller

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart k0sworker 


##Copy Newly generated API ca.crt (the one in /var/lib/k0s/pki folder) to the worker node...
cd ../
cp ca.crt

##Generating worker join token
sudo /usr/local/bin/k0s token create --role worker


###In Worker Node
##Paste the new worker token here
sudo vi /etc/k0s/k0stoken


##This section needs further clarification ig? i don't know which things need to be updated
cd /var/lib/k0s
mv ./* /home/bsfintech/backup/
rm -rf ./*

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart k0sworker

cd pki
##Paste the new ca.crt here
vi ca.crt 
##Adding new kubernetes-ca to the trust store
sudo trust anchor --store ca.crt

sudo systemctl restart k0sworker
